title: Known-object test, TOI-4427.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-4427.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, ≤2.5, 3, 3, 3.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 2%, 2%, 2%, 2%, 2% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 10%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 10%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 164 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 5 light curve(s), forming 37 distinct event(s), 22 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
